request: Implement a slimmer electronics stack; reposition or rotate the battery if useful; make decorative details recessed and flush.
required_outcomes: Keep all 36 Piantor key transforms, the existing case contour and magnetic frame interface.
Retain both Adafruit 1570 and 301230 profiles, hot-swap switches and replaceable electronics.
Use a documented mated connector envelope and a connected lead route before choosing a lower roof.
Preserve complete multicolor decoration as complementary printable volumes at or below the roof.
Keep native CAD, PCB study, STEP/STL, viewer, configuration, previews and print kits consistent.
Verify digital geometry, removal sequence, saved-file readback and public delivery; do not claim physical acceptance.

decision_review.method: Two independent read-only reviews of the same recorded baseline; hashes and clean Git state rechecked after both reports.
decision_review.domain: Keep MCU datum and initially keep battery placement; lower display PCB underside to 12.4 mm; resolve connector and leads before selecting frame height; use closed flush material volumes.
decision_review.adversarial: Same action, conditional on complete connector and cable checks. Do not approve 14.8 mm by shrinking the generic reserve or classify flush colors by triangle height.

finding_dispositions.finding: Floating lead ends and enclosed sled tunnels invalidate the removal sequence.
finding_dispositions.required_resolution: Defined cell and plug interfaces, accessible route/release, static and movement checks including the leads.

finding_dispositions.finding: Generic JST reserve and pigtail footprint do not establish mating or height.
finding_dispositions.required_resolution: Dimensioned side-entry PH connector, 2 mm footprint registration, mating and extraction envelope.

finding_dispositions.finding: Height-based coloring loses flush details and surface-only 3MF does not represent inlays.
finding_dispositions.required_resolution: Explicit closed role volumes and aligned multipart 3MF verified against native exports.
0.4 mm candidate co-print depth, nominal 0.8 mm backing under the 1.2 mm roof, clipped against real material.

finding_dispositions.finding: Supplier terminal variation and exact electrical contact engagement remain unmeasured.
finding_dispositions.required_resolution: Keep these limits explicit; nominal digital clearance is not physical or electrical qualification.

out_of_scope: Physical print, electrical, charging or RF acceptance
A claim of absolute minimum physical height

reset_decision_review.trigger: Authoritative DRC rejects tested top-side reset: zero RESET/SW1 pad clearance, solder-mask bridge and overlapping J1/SW1 courtyards.
reset_decision_review.domain_recommendation: Implement same TL3342 below the PCB with recessed tool access, contingent on all-layer DRC, nominal tool clearance and correctly flipped native/KiCad STEP registration.
reset_decision_review.adversarial_recommendation: Same action and conditions; bottom placement does not eliminate JST through-hole copper or pins.
required_checks: Nets, pad numbering and switch transforms preserved; only specified footprints/interfaces change.
Zero new DRC errors on both boards, including through-hole copper.
All bases include a recessed tool access; all ten frames close the former roof reset opening.
Reset, solder/contact reserves, through-hole pins, magnets, screws and supports do not clash.
Actual KiCad bottom-side model registration matches the native model, without double reflection.

pcb_model_datum_review.decision: Use the KiCad CLI measured board midplane and a -0.04 mm local model Z correction on both faces.
pcb_model_datum_review.domain: Six actual asymmetric witness exports at front/back and three rotations agree with the native targets; explicit correction is required for this KiCad 10.0.6 stack convention.
pcb_model_datum_review.adversarial: Independent review agrees with the measured transform and correction. Final delivered PCB exports must still pass, and dielectric-body equality must not be claimed.

correction_retrospective.trigger: The old tall generic JST reserve and floating cable paths could not establish a physical lower height or service path.
correction_retrospective.cause: Nominal envelopes and illustration-only lead paths were being used as assembly constraints without mating and endpoint registration.
correction_retrospective.correction: Dimensioned PH pair, explicit 2 mm footprint, connected cell-specific lead paths, open-bottom display reliefs, bottom reset and closed flush material volumes.
correction_retrospective.prevention: Bind delivered native/PCB/viewer/material files to fresh geometric and functional readback, including actual KiCad exports and both cell profiles.
correction_retrospective.limits: Physical contact, cable flex, assembly force and manufacturing acceptance remain unqualified.

retained_display_socket_review.trigger: J2 stays on the PCB when nice!view is removed. It was omitted from PartID solids, so the initial stored-wire and PH withdrawal checks did not include it.
retained_display_socket_review.domain: Retain 14.8 mm provisionally, model fixed J2 and correct sled relief; reorient the same side-entry PH and route both leads around a socket end.
retained_display_socket_review.adversarial: Same bounded continuation; current disconnect is not accepted. Require full withdrawal/lift and grip access with retained components, DRC, both battery profiles and native/STEP registration.
retained_display_socket_review.assumptions: 5 mm installed height is published. Width/depth, terminal geometry, exact engagement, flexible routing and forces remain unmeasured.
forbidden_shortcuts: Omitting soldered J2 from retained obstacles
Tilting the PH before demonstrated release
Using a higher roof alone to claim the planar conflict fixed
Substituting loose pigtails without a reviewed design

native_guard_correction.trigger: The initial migration stopped before save at strict key transform comparison after all fourteen flush variants passed.
native_guard_correction.evidence: Only four rotation matrices differed after equivalent quaternion reconstruction; maximum absolute coefficient difference 5.551115123125783e-16. Mesh vertices, facets, translations and case solids matched.
native_guard_correction.correction: Compare rotation/translation matrix values rounded to 12 decimal places, preserving the existing mesh and case checks.
native_guard_correction.validation: Final installation must rerun the guard and saved-file readback; the initial failed run is not accepted.

final_connector_pose.supersedes: Earlier reset XY and PH pose trials; preserves their review history above.
final_connector_pose.release: 5 mm straight toward the key field, then 24 mm lift, with J2, 18 Choc bounds and 18 selected KLP cap bounds retained per half.
final_connector_pose.display_header: Fixed 5 mm female socket; moving 2 mm male spacer and contact reserves included in display. Final sled relief removes the observed 0.24 mm3 ledge contact.
final_connector_pose.qualification: Nominal geometry only; wire deformation, engagement tolerances and forces remain unqualified.

gui_color_correction.trigger: The first GUI-preserving migration rejected JSON-decoded list colors at the FreeCAD DiffuseColor setter; headless geometry trials did not exercise it.
gui_color_correction.correction: Convert color channels to float tuples at GUI assignment, preserving the stored color values and all geometry.
gui_color_correction.validation: GUI-enabled application smoke followed by complete saved/reopened native candidate and colored STEP/viewer readback.

analytic_bounds_correction.trigger: Saved-file assembly-signature guard failed; the original pre-save signature was not persisted. The unaccepted saved candidate was kept unchanged for diagnosis.
analytic_bounds_correction.evidence: All 360 reopened signatures stay identical through recompute. Four stored Adafruit lead BReps differ from GUI shapes only in default bounding boxes. For all four, exact volume/area/symmetric differences are zero; analytic bounds match exactly. Controlled tessellation changes default boxes without changing geometry.
analytic_bounds_correction.cause_status: Tessellation-dependent bounds are demonstrated; their contribution to the original unrecorded mismatch is an evidence-backed inference.
analytic_bounds_correction.correction: Use optimalBoundingBox(False, False) for signature bounds and collision broad-phase pruning. Preserve existing comparison precision and exact Boolean checks. Retain pre/post-save signatures for future failures.
analytic_bounds_correction.validation: Regenerate from the preserved source and require the entire original save/reopen, source, geometry, configuration, service and export checks.
